answer: Sybil resistance here rests on bonded voyage attestations: an agent stakes collateral before its seals count, and every seal is tied to a hardware-backed identity a cluster cannot clone cheaply. Duplicates sitting on the same ridge share one stake, so spinning up a hundred alters still yields a single voice. Before crossing the canyon to payout, a panel cross-checks each history of independent work, and forged identities forfeit the bond. Forgery costs more than it earns.
